command_ingress.database: Existing RAM-only psql configuration; configured and actual database must be yggdrasil; one connection and one explicit transaction, deferred Rollback only. Existing advisory locks, SELECT FOR SHARE/UPDATE and SET LOCAL TIME ZONE are preserved; this is not a PostgreSQL READ ONLY transaction.
command_ingress.files: Two SHA-pinned closed JSON regular 0600 files, maximum 4096 bytes each; no raw input is included in the report. All supplied SHA/source strings validate lowercase fixed-length hexadecimal before output assignment.
command_ingress.shipping: CI artifact companion only, not added to Dockerfile. Existing production-command-operations census remains limited to the three scripts shipped in the production image; all 18 records unchanged.

operator_invocation_requirements.driver_debug: Remove PQGO_DEBUG or set it to 0 in the child environment before exec. lib/pq v1.12.0 reads PQGO_DEBUG=1 at package initialization and enables raw protocol stderr; changing it inside run would be too late.
operator_invocation_requirements.hard_wall: Required external direct-child subprocess timeout of 20 seconds, kill then wait on timeout, preserving partial stdout/stderr and exit evidence. CLI/repository context20 alone is not a hard wall: lib/pq v1.12.0 applies context to TCP dial but startup/auth socket I/O lacks a deadline when connect_timeout is absent; cancel transport may also outlive the query context.
operator_invocation_requirements.initialization: psql.Open only configures sql.Open and pool; no Ping/retry/addon/service initializer. Credentials and raw SQL errors are not logged by the command.
operator_invocation_requirements.timeout_receipt: A killed child without a complete successful rollback report must never be described as having an observed Rollback. OS connection closure is not a rollback receipt.

runtime_build_compatibility.actual_build: CurrentGuestCoreSource reports clean diagnostic VCS revision; never overridden to inspected c025.
runtime_build_compatibility.current_build_dependent_validation: retirementForwardSnapshotTx binding_authority_profile uses GuestBindingAuthorityCurrent and GuestOriginalProfileEnabled, both through guestProductionProfileMatches and guestProtocolAuthoritySupported. Actual stored D11 authority 48888f21acdddaf411094ec525004297c229863f on notify-aws-elastic is explicitly compatible with any clean 40-hex actual build. Entire internal/capacity tree is byte-identical to c025.
runtime_build_compatibility.excluded_current_build_paths: RequestGuestRetirementForwardHistorical, forwardSourceOrigin, forwardRecord, retirementForwardCurrentTx, retirementForwardCallbackContextTx and guestRetirementV2CurrentTx are not invoked by this inspector. Conditional existing-delete and failed-serving terminal readers validate stored records without a current-build equality requirement.
runtime_build_compatibility.historical_issuer_validation: verifyGuestAuthorityIssuerTx uses the stored actual issuer and stored compatibility-map hash; it does not substitute the diagnostic build.
runtime_build_compatibility.interpretation: Later read failure is not proof the original c025 POST reached that stage; changed data and diagnostic execution remain separate facts.

scope: Rollback-only retirement-forward inspection companion and passive diagnostic stages; Source-only review. No admission, deployment, native qualification or retrospective original-409 diagnosis is asserted.

validation.local: Source/text/JSON/hash/diff/gofmt only; Root-read existing data-only census generator executed. No Go functional test, build, vet, list, product import, SQL, auth, Native or provider operation.
validation.source_review: Root read original handoff/full diff; independent peer review and Root final acceptance of the updated integrated Source remain separate.
